Match separately observed fish positions to reference tracks

Source: R/tracking-validation.R
aqt_tracking_match.Rd

Per-frame maximum-cardinality matching uses Euclidean distance in coordinate units. It is class-aware by default and returns only actual one-to-one matched pairs. This is not a cross-view matching method.

Usage

aqt_tracking_match(
  truth,
  pred,
  max_distance,
  class_aware = TRUE,
  evaluated_frames = NULL
)

Arguments

truth, pred

Independent truth and predicted point-track tables.

max_distance

Positive maximum positional error for association.

class_aware

Restrict matches to identical species labels.

evaluated_frames

Optional manifest of all manually annotated frames.

Value

One row per matched pair, with original row IDs and distance.
